# CodeRabbit findings for PAN-4479 (PR #4911)

CodeRabbit posted 2 inline finding(s). CodeRabbit is advisory: nothing waits for these,
but each one gets an answer, either a fix or a reply with your reason.

- Thread 4459562467 · src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/sharing/SharedConversationView.tsx:433 [Minor]: Preserve admitted content during automatic connection retry.
  https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/4911#discussion_r4459562467
- Thread 4459562477 · src/dashboard/server/services/share-host.ts:318 [Minor]: Terminate the socket when `openHost` fails after it opened the connection.
  https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/4911#discussion_r4459562477

## What to do

1. Read each thread (open its link, or the code at the path and line).
2. If you agree with a finding, fix it.
3. If you reject a finding, reply on its thread with your reason:
   `gh api repos/eltmon/overdeck/pulls/4911/comments/<thread id>/replies -f body="<reason>"`
4. If you changed code: run the quality gates on what you touched, commit, push, then run `pan review request PAN-4479`.
   If you only replied, you are done.
5. If PR #4911 has already merged when you read this, nothing more lands on it: open a follow-up issue
   for the findings you agree with instead of pushing.

4. Run the project's build and tests to verify nothing broke
5. Commit and push ALL changes

2. Commit and push ALL changes
3. ONLY THEN resubmit: pan review request PAN-4479 -m "Fixed sync-target-branch"
